node_contract.what: Run pass 29 critic review and harden physical evidence-file bundle validation.
node_contract.why: A ledger entry naming a file is not proof unless the actual file is included in the evidence bundle.
node_contract.how: Add --evidence-file arguments, compare ledger file-like evidence entries to provided file basenames, require handoff/drill/replay IDs in evidence file contents, and add regression checks.
node_contract.where: df-production-sre-handoff installed skill, workspace bundle, validation runner, and project-book records.
node_contract.when: Before future production handoff bundles are accepted as evidence-backed handoffs.
node_contract.who: Codex as responsible fixer; human owner as Ralph-loop driver and accountable release approver.
node_contract.how_good: Complete evidence-file bundle passes while missing files or ledger-file drift rejects.

expert_debate.system_theorist: The bundle now connects records, but the artifact evidence layer still needs closure so the ledger does not become a naming illusion.
expert_debate.requirements_governance_architect: Evidence provided by a work ledger must resolve to actual artifact files or durable IDs with explicit residual risk.
expert_debate.verification_safety_critic: File-like evidence strings are bypassable unless the validator sees those files and checks their contents.
expert_debate.synthesis: Require evidence-file bundle inputs and reject ledgers that name files not provided.

human_decisions: Human owner requested pass 29 and asked to fix any new findings.
assumptions: Pass 29 is a patch-level physical evidence-file hardening pass, not a full artifact-management system.
risks: Evidence-file validation proves presence and key ID mentions, not full semantic correctness of every document.
Full greenfield and brownfield simulations remain future work.
